distance_model.formula_water_policy: dotted water is hydration; parenthesized/bracketed water is structural water
distance_model.map_coordinates: landmark classical MDS with Gower interpolation; map distances are approximate

categories.polymorph: Same parsed chemistry and formula water; differentiated by structure only.
categories.hydration_variant: Same framework chemistry; differs in dotted water of hydration.
categories.structural_water_variant: Same framework chemistry; differs in parenthesized or bracketed structural water.
categories.redox_variant: Same cation elements but a changed oxidation-state distribution.
categories.cation_analogue: Same anion framework with cation substitution; valence evidence may be incomplete.
categories.anion_group_analogue: Same cations and residual anions with substituted oxyanion groups.
categories.extra_anion_analogue: Same cation and oxyanion framework with residual-anion substitution.
categories.coupled_substitution: Coordinated cation and residual-anion substitutions in one anion framework.
categories.compositional_subset: One parsed formula feature set is a strict subset of the other.
categories.same_structural_group: Different composition components within the same named structural group.
categories.multiple_substitutions: More than one compositional component differs materially.
categories.distant_analogue: No more specific rule applies at the selected neighbourhood scale.
